# Compiler workflow fixtures

All data in this directory is synthetic and redistribution-safe.

- `benchmark-registers.csv` contains 150 generated register rows for the optional local timing profile.
- `fallback-merged-layout.txt` preserves the merged-cell failure shape needed when direct source intake reaches the public compiler command.

The normal transcript suite does not assert wall-clock timing. `--benchmark` records the local machine envelope and applies the five-minute threshold.
